description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer miscellaneous functions, including play, pause, setEos, setVolume, and getVolume, using Google Test framework. It tests interactions with a mock WebAudioGstPlayer and verifies thread synchronization and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: RialtoServerWebAudioPlayerMiscellaneousFunctionsTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from WebAudioPlayerTestBase, providing setup and utility methods for testing WebAudioPlayer miscellaneous functions.

methods.name: notifyApiCalled
methods.description: Sets the threadDone flag to true and notifies condition variable to signal that an API call has been made.

methods.name: waitForApiCalled
methods.description: Waits for the notifyApiCalled to be invoked, with a timeout of 200 milliseconds, asserting success.
